name: Maybank Singapore Limited

scam_info.sample: Advisory on Phishing Scams Impersonating Courier Companies 23 November 2026 Beware of phishing scams involving scammers impersonating courier companies through unsolicited messages.
scam_info.notes: 'New Scam Alerts' list: 31 dated advisories 2024-01-17..2026-11-23 (actively maintained). Narrative MOs (courier, hotel-booking, inheritance, LTA/government impersonation, W-8BEN compliance phishing emails since Jan 2026); no concrete fake domains/numbers. Static .page HTML; site has no robots.txt (404) and /sitemap.xml 404.

scam_info.sample: Maybank has removed all clickable links from its emails and SMSes since 31 January 2022. If you have received a message from Maybank with a clickable link, it's likely that the message is not legitimate.
scam_info.notes: Linked from ScamShield bank-hotline list. Kill switch, card block, 12-hour cooling period from 26 Oct 2025, anti-malware app checks ('Unofficial M2U Mobile Banking App Downloaded'); links anti-scam FAQ PDFs under /iwov-resources/sg/pdf/faq/personal/eservices/security-alerts/online-threats/ (maybank-anti-scam-faq.pdf, enhanced-security-measures-against-malware-scams-faq.pdf).

hotlines: 1800-MAYBANK (1800-629 2265) (Maybank hotline; press *1 to report unauthorised transactions / kill switch)
